policy_name_ja: 積立利率変動型個人年金保険（21）（通貨指定型）
notes: Own rate page (index_hendo_choice_21_01), history from 2022-10-01, and the only product of the (21) form with AUD; no other name shares it. A predecessor 指数連動年金 (code 190) is listed on the hub as discontinued and not collected.

Product type indexed_annuity (changed from fixed_annuity on 2026-11-17). The saved brochure (brochure_shisurendou2_hanyo, sources/dfl/docs/) shows the (21) form is index-linked: at the end of the 積立利率保証期間 the 年金原資額 is the 基本移行原資額 (fixed by the contract-date 積立利率, never below 100% of the premium) plus an 指数連動移行原資額 = premium x rise of the 参照指数 since the 基準日 x 連動率 (zero if the index has not risen). The rate page publishes only the 積立利率 by currency and 5/10-year guarantee period, which is what the CSVs hold; the 連動率 and index values are not collected.
The distributors list is the 銀行・信用金庫・信用組合・証券 section of the product page.

Launch date: 2022-02-01, the first sale of 『指数連動年金』 (SMBC, SMBC Nikko Securities, SMBC Trust Bank) per the insurer's news release of 2022-01-27 (id=1001); this product is its successor edition 『指数連動年金２』, on sale from 2022-10-03 per the release of 2022-09-30 (id=1017, snapshot sources/dfl/pages/release_1017_2026-11-17.pdf). Formal name 積立利率変動型個人年金保険（21）（通貨指定型）. Retrieved 2026-11-17.
notes_en: Rate history starts on 1 October 2022 and covers USD, AUD and JPY with 5 and 10-year guarantee periods.
It is the only product on this form with AUD, and no other name shares its rates.

Classed as an indexed annuity: per the brochure, at the end of the guarantee period a fixed amount of at least the premium is topped up by the rise in a reference index. The published rate is the fixed crediting rate; the index participation is not collected.
A predecessor product is discontinued and not collected. Launch date is that of the first edition (1 February 2022); this edition followed on 3 October 2022.
